$comment: LAYER 1 - native rate-limit failover, always on, no gateway involved:
fallbackModel is Claude Code's own chain. When the primary model is
overloaded or rate limited, the session continues on the next model in
this chain automatically for the rest of the turn - no /model switch, no
interruption. This is the answer to 'a rate limit must not require the
operator to switch models'. Chains are capped at three entries.
LAYER 2 - the OmniRoute gateway (311 models) is opt-in and lives in
.claude/settings.local.json, written by ops/omniroute.ps1. It remaps the
opus/sonnet/haiku picker slots onto gateway routing aliases. See
